sql: select count(*),count(distinct s.security_id),min(o.pvm),max(o.pvm),sum(o.open is null or o.high is null or o.low is null or o.close is null),sum(o.open<=0 or o.high<=0 or o.low<=0 or o.close<=0),sum(o.high<o.low or o.high<o.open or o.high<o.close or o.low>o.open or o.low>o.close),sum(o.volume is null),sum(o.volume=0),sum(o.volume<0) from f.security s join o.osakedata o on o.osake=s.current_ticker where o.market='usa' and o.pvm<='2026-10-12'
select s.current_ticker,s.active from f.security s where not exists(select 1 from o.osakedata o where o.osake=s.current_ticker and o.market='usa' and o.pvm<='2026-10-12')
select substr(o.pvm,1,4),count(*),count(distinct s.security_id) from f.security s join o.osakedata o on o.osake=s.current_ticker where o.market='usa' and o.pvm<='2026-10-12' group by 1

select count(*) from (select close/lag(close) over(partition by o.osake order by o.pvm) r from f.security s join o.osakedata o on o.osake=s.current_ticker where o.market='usa' and o.pvm<='2026-10-12') where r>2 or r<0.5
select count(*) from(select s.security_id,o.pvm from f.security s join o.osakedata o on o.osake=s.current_ticker where o.market='usa' group by 1,2 having count(*)>1)
select current_ticker from f.security where exchange is null
